name: site-manual-generator
description: 输入网站名称或网址，自动爬取分析并生成 DOCX 格式的结构化操作手册。支持交互式调整、多 LLM 提供商、MCP 协议。
descriptionEn: Automatically crawl any website and generate structured operation manuals in DOCX format. Supports interactive customization, multiple LLM providers, and MCP protocol.

interface.shortDescription: 输入网址，一键生成 DOCX 操作手册
interface.longDescription: A powerful tool that automatically crawls any website, analyzes its features using AI, and generates a well-structured operation manual in DOCX format. Supports interactive customization, multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Ollama, etc.), and MCP protocol for integration with Cursor, Claude Desktop, and more.
defaultPrompt: Use site-manual-generator to generate an operation manual for this website.
